<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>
<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>
<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>
<td class="nump">1.7143%<span></span>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="re">
<td class="pl custom" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_ck0002056516_PercenatgeOfPreIncentiveFundFee', window );">Percenatge of Pre Incentive Fund Fee</a></td>
<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>
<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>
<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>
<td class="nump">12.50%<span></span>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_IncentiveFeeDescription', window );">Incentive Fee, Description</a></td>
<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>
<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>
<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>
<td class="text">no incentive fee based on Pre-Incentive Fee Net Investment Income Returns in any calendar quarter in which the Fund&#8217;s Pre-Incentive Fee Net Investment Income Returns do not exceed the hurdle rate of 1.50%;&#8226;100% of the dollar amount of the Pre-Incentive Fee Net Investment Income with respect to that portion of such Pre-Incentive Fee Net Investment Income Returns, if any, that exceeds the hurdle rate but is less than a rate of return of 1.7143% (6.8571% annualized). This portion of the Fund&#8217;s Pre-Incentive Fee Net Investment Income Returns (which exceeds the hurdle rate but is less than 1.7143%) is referred to as the &#8220;catch-up.&#8221; The &#8220;catch-up&#8221; is meant to provide the Adviser with approximately 12.5% of the Fund&#8217;s Pre-Incentive Fee Net Investment Income Returns as if a hurdle rate did not apply if this net investment income exceeds 1.7143% in any calendar quarter; and&#8226;12.5% of the dollar amount of the Fund&#8217;s Pre-Incentive Fee Net Investment Income Returns, if any, that exceed a rate of return of 1.7143% (6.8571% annualized). This reflects that once the hurdle rate is reached and the catch-up is achieved, 12.5% of all Pre-Incentive Fee Net Investment Income Returns thereafter are allocated to the Adviser.<span></span>
</td>
</tr>
